    t7."albumin_urine_mg_l_si",
    t8."creatinine_urine_mg_dl"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening t0 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t0.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes t1 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t1.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_glycohemoglobin t2 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t2.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_fasting_glucose_mg_dl t3 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t3.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_race_hispanic_origin t4 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t4.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_gender t5 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t5.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_creatinine_mg_dl t6 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t6.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_albumin_urine_mg_l_si t7 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t7.respondent_sequence_number

-- STEP 1.1: Includes participants whose age is older than 20 years
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "age_in_years_at_screening" > 20;

-- STEP 1.2: From the above group, include participants who meet any of the diabetes criteria: self-reported diabetes diagnosis is yes, glycohemoglobin (HbA1C) >= 6.5%, or fasting glucose (mg/dl)>=126.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes'
   OR f."glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5
   OR f."fasting_glucose_mg_dl" >= 126;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude participants with missing race
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."race_hispanic_origin" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude participants with missing age
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants with missing gender
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."gender" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude participants with missing serum creatinine (mg/dl)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step4 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."creatinine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.5: Exclude participants with missing urine albumin mg/L
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step5 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step4 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."albumin_urine_mg_l_si" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.6: Exclude participants with missing creatinine urine mg/dl
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step6 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step5 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."creatinine_urine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step6;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 ALB-CKD
-- Calculate eGFR (mL/min/1.73m^2) using CKD-EPI 2009 formula
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_egfr AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."gender" = 'Female' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -0.329) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening") * 1.018 * 1.159
    WHEN f."gender" = 'Female' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" != 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -0.329) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.7, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening") * 1.018
    WHEN f."gender" = 'Male' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -0.411) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening") * 1.159
    WHEN f."gender" = 'Male' AND f."race_hispanic_origin" != 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 141 * POWER(LEAST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -0.411) * POWER(GREATEST(f."creatinine_mg_dl" / 0.9, 1), -1.209) * POWER(0.993, f."age_in_years_at_screening")
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "egfr_ml_min_1_73m_2"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Calculate UACR (mg/g)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  (100.0 * (f."albumin_urine_mg_l_si" / f."creatinine_urine_mg_dl")) AS "uacr_mg_g"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Determine ALB-CKD status
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_alb_ckd AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN e."egfr_ml_min_1_73m_2" < 60 AND u."uacr_mg_g" >= 30 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS "alb_ckd"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_egfr e ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = e."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_uacr u ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = u."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  alb."alb_ckd"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_alb_ckd alb ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = alb."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 6: Final Output ==========
SELECT * FROM temp_final_table;

-- STEP: Create merged final table with design variables + in_analysis flag

    wd."respondent_sequence_number",
    wd."masked_variance_pseudo_psu",

    wd."survey_weight",
    CASE WHEN ft."respondent_sequence_number" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "in_analysis",
    ft."alb_ckd"
FROM weight_design wd
LEFT JOIN temp_final_table ft
  ON wd."respondent_sequence_number" = ft."respondent_sequence_number";
